title: Here. Use my phone
grammar: Prepositions and expressions of position and location; The imperative
pair_game: Say a word. Your partner draws it in 10 seconds. Then swap!

grammar_box.title: Where is it? / Do it!
rows: The chair is **next to** the desk.
grammar_box.tip: Imperative: start with the verb — Sit down! Don’t run! (buyruq gap)

questions: Describe your bedroom — what furniture is in it and where is everything?
What rooms are in your home? Which room do you spend the most time in?
Where do you usually do your homework — in your bedroom or another room?
What is on your desk right now? Describe what you see.
Is your room tidy or messy? Do you clean it yourself?
Where is your phone right now? Do you use it a lot at home?
Describe your living room. What furniture does it have?
What is your favorite room at home and why?
Where do you keep your school books and supplies at home?
If you could add one new thing to your bedroom, what would it be and where would you put it?
starters: In my bedroom there is a … . It’s next to … .
We have a … and a … . I spend time in the … .
I do my homework in the … .
On my desk there is a … and a … .
My room is … . I clean it / My mom cleans it.
My phone is in/on … . I use it … .
Our living room has a … and a … .
My favourite room is the … because … .
I want a … . I can put it next to … .
samples: Describe your bedroom — what furniture is in it and where is everything?
My bed is **next to** the window. My desk is **near** the door. My lamp is **on** the desk.
Where is your phone right now? Do you use it a lot at home?
My phone is **in** my bag. I use it for games, but not a lot.
What is your favorite room at home and why?
My favourite room is the kitchen. My mom makes plov there. It smells great!

game.title: Find someone who…
game.rules: Walk around the class. Ask: “Do you have a … in your bedroom?” Write a name.

… has a lamp on the desk
… has a TV in the living room
… has a cat or dog at home

mini_talk.title: My bedroom
plan: Say what is in your room
Say if it is tidy or messy
mini_talk.model: This is my bedroom. There is a bed, a desk and a chair. My bed is **next to** the window. My desk is **near** the door. My books are **on** the shelf. My ball is **under** the bed! My room is tidy. My rule: **Don’t open** my door! **Knock**, please!

cando: say where things are with in, on, under
